terra.problem: It calls the people in verse 16 a different group from those in verses 14 and 15. The passage does not explicitly say the groups are distinct.
Papa says he leaped off his gold base, but the base is part of him and always stays with him.
Moses being Israel’s leader is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
David being Israel’s king is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Joseph being one of Jacob’s sons needs a reference. The explanation also quotes God speaking as “I” without first identifying Him as the speaker.
It calls Elijah a messenger, but this passage says he is a prophet who will be sent and does not call him a messenger.
Samuel being a prophet is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Isaiah being a prophet is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
It says prophets are not in the verse, then identifies Elijah as a prophet in the very next sentence.
